disclaimer: Climatic optimum ranges, GDD thermal thresholds and reproductive heat/frost references have different definitions and should not be conflated. Actual crop damage depends on variety, growth stage and exposure duration.

optimumClimateC.basis: Indicative climatic range (not the optimum for every growth stage)

thermal.heatReproductiveBasis: Heat-stress reference during reproduction; depends on growth stage, variety and exposure duration
thermal.coldFloweringBasis: Critical frost range at flowering (FAO frost protection, Table 4.5). Indicative; depends on growth stage, duration and acclimation.
thermal.coldFloweringSource: FAO, Frost protection: fundamentals, practice, and economics, Tabla 4.5; coincide con CSV de TerraAI
